mapper.select: select count(*) from wish where MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} and PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.delete: delete from wish where member_id = #{memberId} and PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.select: select w.WISH_ID, w.MEMBER_ID, w.PRODUCT_ID, p.PRODUCT_TITLE, pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME as title_image from WISH w join product p on w.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID left join productimage pi on p.PRODUCT_ID = pi.PRODUCT_ID where pi.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 and w.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
